{{*}} [[Ring of dueling]] ([[Emir's Arena]]) |music = * [[Al Kharid (music track)|Al Kharid]] * [[Arabian]] * [[Arabian 2]] |map = {{Map|name=Al Kharid|x=3290|y=3185|height=300|width=300|zoom=2}} |type = settlement |leagueRegion = Desert }} '''Al Kharid''' is a large city in the north of the [[Kharidian Desert]], and the only desert city open to [[Free-to-play|non-members]]. Players in the city do not suffer from the [[Desert heat|desert effect]]. Al Kharid is popular among free-to-play players because it contains one of the closest [[Al Kharid bank|banks]] to a [[range]] and to a furnace, two reasonably close [[fishing spots]], and a [[tanner]], [[Ellis]]. Also popular is the nearby [[Al Kharid mine|mining site]], which contains almost all ores up to and including [[Adamantite ore|adamant]]. ==Transportation== [[File:Pay-toll.png|thumb|280px|[[Border Guard]]s at the Al Kharid gate.]] *{{Plink|Amulet of glory}} — {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the palace. *{{Plink|Gnome glider|pic=Gnome goggles}} — northern Al Kharid. *{{Plink|Ring of dueling}} — [[Emir's Arena]], just north-east of Al Kharid. *{{Plink|Ring of the elements}} — near to the [[Fire Altar]] entrance, north of the city. *{{plink|Minigame teleport|pic=Minigame icon}} — [[Rat Pits|Sorceress's Garden]]. Usable once every 20 minutes, and only after asking [[Osman]]/[[Selim]] if they need any help. *{{Plink|Achievement diary cape}} — [[Shantay Pass]], just south of the city. *{{plink|Desert amulet 4|pic=Minigame icon}} — [[Kalphite Cave|Kalphite cave]], near the [[Shantay Pass]]. *{{Plink|Cowbell amulet}} — inside the [[Lumbridge cow field|cow field]], just beyond the western gate. *{{Plink|Lumbridge Teleport}} — [[Lumbridge Castle]], decently west of the city. From [[Lumbridge]], players can use the toll gate which costs either 10 [[coins]], or nothing if you have completed the [[Prince Ali Rescue]] [[Quests|quest]]. Alternatively, members can use the level 8 [[Agility]] [[shortcut]] to grapple to and from the [[Lumbridge Swamp]]. From [[Varrock]], players can go south via the road alongside the [[Al Kharid mine]]. Members can also get to Al Kharid via the one-way [[Fairy rings|fairy ring]] from [[Zanaris]]' market area, which brings them to the bank.[[File:Zeke's Superior Scimitars..png|thumb|250px|[[Zeke's Superior Scimitars]]]] == History == Al Kharid has a long history. Most recently, in the year 169, [[Prince Ali]], the Emir's son, was kidnapped by the infamous [[Lady Keli]], causing the greatly upset Emir to retreat to his private chambers. However, [[Chancellor Hassan]] was able to enlist an adventurer to rescue the prince. The city is still ruled by the [[the Emir|Emir]], although the vast majority of the work has been taken over by [[Hassan|Chancellor Hassan]] since the Emir's son was kidnapped. ==Features== === Buildings === {| class="wikitable" !Building !Description |- |Agility course finish line |The final building of the [[Rooftop Agility Courses|rooftop course]]. The building itself contains many pieces of pottery, 2 statues, and some [[leather boots]]. |- |[[Al Kharid bank]] |A [[Al Kharid bank|bank]] in the south-west of the city, often heavily-populated due to the proximity of the [[tanner]], [[range]], and [[furnace]]. |- |[[Al Kharid General Store]] |A [[general store]] east of the [[Al Kharid Palace|palace]]. The store is a popular among [[Ironman Mode|ironmen]] selling recently-[[Crafting#Leather|crafted]] [[leather armour]]. |- |[[Al Kharid Palace]] |The largest building in Al Kharid, the residence of [[the Emir]], and the seat of government for the emirate of Al Kharid. |- |Al Kharid workshop |A workshop just north of the bank, containing a valuable furnace location for [[free-to-play]] players. |- |[[Dommik's Crafting Store.|Dommik's Crafting Store]] |A [[Crafting]] [[Shop|store]] north-east of the [[Al Kharid Palace|palace]], stocking various Crafting supplies such as [[Chisel|chisels]], [[Needle|needles]], [[Thread|threads]], and almost all [[Mould|moulds]]. |- |[[Karim]]'s kitchen |A building with [[range]], directly north of the [[Al Kharid bank|bank]]. A kebab can be bought from Karim for {{Coins|1}}, but must be done through dialogue. |- |[[Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar.|Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar]] |A [[Platelegs|plateleg]] [[Shop|store]] south of the [[Al Kharid General Store|general store]]. It sells all standard metal platelegs up to and including [[adamant]]. |- |[[Ranael's Super Skirt Store.|Ranael's Super Skirt Store]] |A [[plateskirt]] [[Shop|store]] east of the [[Al Kharid Palace|palace]] which stocks identical merchandise to Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar, except the [[armour]] is plateskirts. |- |[[Sorceress]]' home |Home of the Sorceress, who will let players into [[Sorceress's Garden|her garden]]. |- |[[Zeke's Superior Scimitars.|Zeke's Superior Scimitars]] |A [[scimitar]] [[shop]] north-east of the [[Al Kharid bank|bank]] which sells all [[scimitars]] up to and including [[mithril]]. |} Two other buildings, immediately east and west of the [[silk trader]], are decorated but have no known owner. There is also an empty tent west of [[Dommik]], containing nothing but a [[bucket]]. === Vendors and stalls === [[File:Dommik's Crafting Store..png|thumb|250px|[[Dommik's Crafting Store.]]]] [[File:Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar..png|thumb|250px|[[Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar]]]] Al Kharid also features several vendors without their own building: * [[Ali Morrisane]] is found east of the [[gem trader]] to the north-east of the city near the blue star [[Quests|quest]] [[icon]] {{SCP|Quest}}. He sells various [[items]], and, once [[The Feud]] is completed, he will open various other [[shop]]s if you set up merchanting opportunities for him. * The [[Gem Trader|gem trader]] east of the gate to [[Lumbridge]] sells one cut and uncut sapphire and emerald, and will buy rubies and diamonds. Players can buy them if they've they've been sold to the shop by someone else. * [[Osman]], just outside the [[Al Kharid Palace|Al Kharid palace]], can replace lost [[Keris]] daggers for 20,000 coins after [[Contact!]]. Additionally, [[Thieving]] experience rewards can be claimed by trading in [[Sq'irkjuice|Sq'irk juice]] obtained in the [[Sorceress's Garden]] minigame. * The [[silk trader]], north-east of the [[Zeke's Superior Scimitars]], is a quick and easy way for newer [[members]] to gain small amounts of money. If the player is prepared to click through a lengthy dialogue, they can buy [[silk]] cheaply (3 [[coins]]) which can be sold for a profit at a [[general store]] other than the one in Al Kharid. If you refuse at the first time, he'll lower the price to 2 coins. [[File:Ali's Discount Wares..png|thumb|250px|[[Ali's Discount Wares.]]]] === Skill training areas === * The [[Al Kharid Rooftop Course|Al Kharid Agility course]] is a [[Rooftop Agility Courses|rooftop course]] which can be started on the wall of [[Ellis]]' store building. * The [[Al Kharid mine]], north of the city, contains rocks up to and including [[Adamantite ore|adamant ore]]. * There is a [[cactus patch]] on the east side of the city, used in the [[Farming]] [[Skills|skill]]. * The [[ferry]] just south of the bank can be used to reach the [[Tempoross]] [[Minigames|minigame]]. * The [[Fire Altar]], used in the [[Runecraft]] skill, is located just north of the [[Emir's Arena]] * There is a [[furnace]] north of [[Al Kharid bank|the bank]]. In [[Free-to-play Melee training|free-to-play]], it is the second only to the [[Edgeville furnace]] in terms of closeness to a bank. * The [[Sorceress's Garden]] can be accessed from the [[Sorceress]]' home near the Shantay PAss. It offers an alternative method for training [[Thieving]]. === Other === * The [[Shantay Pass]] south of the city acts as a barrier between Al kharid and the rest of the desert. Players must buy a pass for {{Coins|10}} coins to pass through. They can also get thrown in the jail or sent to [[Port Sarim]] for belligerence. * The [[Emir's Arena]] is a massive combat area found north-east of Al Kharid. The building acts as a [[Player killing|PvP]] arena which lets players fight under set rules or account types.
